program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((n (rows g)))
             (build-grid (* n 2)
                         (* n 2)
                         (r c)
                         (let ((qr (/ r n))
                               (qc (/ c n))
                               (lr (mod r n))
                               (lc (mod c n)))
                           (cond
                             ((and (zero? qr) (zero? qc)) (at g lr lc))
                             ((and (zero? qr) (= qc 1)) (at g lc (- (- n 1) lr)))
                             ((and (= qr 1) (zero? qc)) (at g (- (- n 1) lr) (- (- n 1) lc)))
                             (else (at g (- (- n 1) lc) lr)))))))))
